description: Makes Meridian execution commands mandatory rather than merely available. Implementers must record declared validation, budgeted evidence, and broad exploration through the execution CLI; review-required tasks must pass ready-check before READY_FOR_REVIEW. Nonterminal legacy tasks must reconcile their generated execution contract before substantive work.
delta: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md add the execution-command gate. tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md changes task-blueprint v10 to v11 and records that execution commands are required. `meridian execution reconcile <TASK-ID> --apply` refreshes only the generated execution-contract block of a nonterminal task; terminal task records remain historical and are not retrofitted with invented evidence.
verification: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md carry capability=execution-command-gate v1
execution preflight rejects a legacy generated contract until meridian execution reconcile is applied
execution reconcile never rewrites an ACCEPTED, ANSWERED, or INCONCLUSIVE task
